Temporary generators were removed after raster generation and are not repository content. No third-party model, mesh, GLB, texture, environment image, logo, acquired asset, or planned alien-moon environment content was imported or redistributed. The gameplay-context background is an original abstract ice-toned field made only from gradients and polygons.
